About me

Hello, I'm Phil. I've been a web designer and developer for many, many years. Since being made redundant in October 2026, I decided to branch out on my own and start a business which involves some passions as well as the career I'm experienced in.

Treading the boards

My first real passion was theatre. I did a RSA Performing Arts Certificate in 1987 -1989 (as well as 3 'A' Levels, no idea how I find the time) at Stockton & Billingham Technical College. Despite the college's name, it was quite a renowned course - we had visiting lecturers from New York, a local playwright teaching us & the course spawned some actors who are working to this day.

I played countless roles, notably learning how to dance the Charleston & a very loud Queen of Hearts in Alice in Wonderland ("off with his head!!").

Musical switch

I'd been a songwriter throughout this time. While at university I wrote musicals (!) & performed solo. Then I got a band together - actually strictly various bands all with me and a mate, a drummer, at their core. That was when I really got interested in writing and performing music.

These days, [mumbles] years on I'm more interested in writing and production (and making films to go along with the music).
